info.title: Baki-dou: The Invincible Samurai
info.synopsis: Baki è annoiato. Dopo la conclusione della battaglia epica tra padre e figlio, lui continua a fare combattimenti underground e ad allenarsi senza fermarsi, ma deve sempre reprimere il suo sbadiglio causato dalla noia. Nessuno stimolo o pericolo può portare eccitazione in lui in questo momento. Ora, con l'inclusione del Primo Ministro Giapponese nel circuito, un grande progetto di clonazione di massa sta provando a clonare Miyamoto Musashi, uno dei padri delle arti marziali in Giappone. Un'altra battaglia di proporzioni epiche attende Baki!

episodes.title: The Unstoppable Yawn
episodes.synopsis: With the greatest father-son battle on earth concluded, Baki experiences overwhelming boredom. Meanwhile, Tokugawa advances his unprecedented experiment.

episodes.title: THE BEAT
episodes.synopsis: As the other martial artists battle restlessness, Kaoru Hanayama asks Tokugawa for a favor. Deep underground, the cloning project enters its final phase.

episodes.title: The Countenance of Musashi
episodes.synopsis: As Professor John accepts Sabuko's arcane methods against scientific reasoning, Hanayama gears up for an all-out fistfight with Yujiro on Tokyo's streets.

episodes.title: Boy
episodes.synopsis: After facing Japan's greatest modern swordsman, the peerless Musashi Miyamoto demands the most skilled fighters in the country. Baki steps forward.

episodes.title: Otherworldly Strength
episodes.synopsis: Baki unleashes his fastest strike — but the samurai is faster. Later, as Musashi roams the city, his actions catch the attention of other martial artists.

episodes.title: Real Sword
episodes.synopsis: The first to move is Doppo Orochi. After a brief tussle, he asks Musashi to use a real blade. How will God's Hand fare against the sword saint's steel?

episodes.title: Feather
episodes.synopsis: Sea King Retsu arrives to face Musashi and trains intensively under the watchful eye of Sea Emperor Kaku to master the secret technique: Xiaoli.

episodes.title: You Are Defeated!
episodes.synopsis: The battle between kenpo master Retsu and sword master Musashi Miyamoto begins! While Retsu unleashes long-range weapon attacks, Musashi closes in!?

episodes.title: Sea King Retsu
episodes.synopsis: Barely standing after Musashi's barrage of brutal attacks, Retsu forces his broken body forward and adopts a familiar stance. Can he turn the tide?

episodes.title: Sekigahara
episodes.synopsis: The deathmatch between Retsu and Musashi comes to a devastatingly brutal conclusion. Baki visits Izo Motobe for guidance and flies into a rage.

episodes.title: Buddy
episodes.synopsis: After defeating Japan's kendo champ, Musashi faces jujutsu master Goki Shibukawa, who greets the samurai with a firm handshake — and a punch to the face.

episodes.title: Tough Body
episodes.synopsis: The strongest being on Earth clashes with the strongest samurai in history at the Tokugawa estate! Yujiro demands Musashi face him with two swords.

episodes.title: Practical Fighter
episodes.synopsis: Jack Hammer arrives at the Tokugawa estate hoping to fight Musashi, but first must defeat Motobe, who's determined to be the next to take on the samurai.

episodes.synopsis: Mentre Cayman e Nikaido raggiungono Mastema, Haru scambia due chiacchiere con un umano.

episodes.title: Dolce casa / Gioventù splendente / I ricordi continuano a girare e girare / Torna a casa
episodes.synopsis: En vuole vendere dei pessimi funghi e Cayman sembra essersi ricordato qualcosa di importante.

episodes.title: I coleotteri dorati sono ricchi / Il macellaio carino / La porta sul passato
episodes.synopsis: So the Cross-Eyes gang figured they’d make the landlord’s murder look like a suicide, huh? As for Asu, who dared to keep things from me, I made sure he paid for it.

episodes.title: L'incontro sotto la pioggia / Compagni di viaggio / L'ultima notte per quei due
episodes.synopsis: Looks like Ebisu got her memory back, thanks to eating some weird mushrooms, and now she’s all eager to head back to her parents’ place.

episodes.title: Addio, Caiman / Bolle di memoria
episodes.synopsis: En’s found the lizard guy and Nikaido, and they’re going at it hard. Meanwhile, the Cross-Eyes guys are sitting around swapping stories about their boss.

episodes.title: Il mio piano segreto / Spedizione occhi crociati / Riunione deformata
episodes.synopsis: Fujita's losing his mind trying to get Kikurage to bring Ebisu back to life. The Cross-Eyes guys are scrambling for cash, and things around En are starting to get kind of dicey.

episodes.title: Caos e shock / La scatola nera / Stanza 501
episodes.synopsis: I never imagined En would go down that easily. The sorcerers are thrown into total chaos. And now I get why Nikaido doesn't use magic.

episodes.title: L'area del pogo / Notizie sugli Occhi crociati
episodes.synopsis: The Cross-Eyes boss has finally shown up. The En Family's been wiped out, and it looks like the Cross-Eyes have taken over that huge mansion.

episodes.title: Manzo fortunato / Magia avanzata
episodes.synopsis: Looks like they've found missing Kikurage. And that bastard Asu, well, Kawajiri now, is sneaking around, up to something weird again. That Haru chick’s getting a little too carried away.

episodes.title: Un incontro romantico e violento / Domande e risposte
episodes.synopsis: Looks like Kawajiri and Nikaido have slipped into En's mansion, which the Cross-Eyes have taken over. There, Nikaido runs right into Aikawa. The mystery surrounding the Cross-Eyes boss just keeps getting deeper.

info.title: Shurato - L'epica degli dei celesti: le tenebre della creazione
info.synopsis: Conclusa la battaglia per la Sfera Celeste, Shurato e Gai vengono cancellati dalla storia. Quando una nuova minaccia emerge sulla Terra, gli Otto Guardiani sono chiamati a indagare. In un mondo che non lo ricorda più, Shurato cerca di ritrovare i suoi amici, mentre un misterioso nemico trama nell'ombra per realizzare un oscuro piano che potrebbe mettere in pericolo entrambi i mondi.

info.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
info.synopsis: Sasaki è un impiegato di 45 anni intrappolato nella monotonia del lavoro e della vita quotidiana. L'unico momento di sollievo nella sua routine è la breve visita serale a un supermercato, dove la gentilezza e il sorriso della giovane cassiera Yamada riescono, anche solo per un attimo, a fargli dimenticare lo stress. Una sera, però, Yamada ha già finito il turno e l'uomo, deluso, si rifugia dietro il negozio per fumare. Lì incontra Tayama: una donna misteriosa, schietta e diretta, molto diversa dalla dolce Yamada... eppure, qualcosa in lei gli sembra stranamente familiare. Tra una sigaretta e l’altra, Sasaki scopre in Tayama una nuova compagna di silenzi e parole non dette. E così, tra i corridoi illuminati del supermercato e l’ombra tranquilla dell’area fumatori, la sua vita inizia lentamente a cambiare...

episodes.title: Continuando con te sul retro del supermercato

info.title: Mission: Yozakura Family 2 Part 2
info.synopsis: Secondo cour di Mission: Yozakura Family 2

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: The series of incidents involving the former Yozakura heads turn out to part of Momo's plot to resurrect his beloved wife, Rei. As he whispers about his twisted love for his family, Momo vanishes from Mutsumi and the others' sight. Meanwhile, Kyoichiro, who was saved by Taiyo's Profuse Blooming of 10,000 Flowers, returns home to his siblings. The touching reunion is short-lived, as in order to make him reflect after trying to sacrifice himself to protect the family, a "Day of Family Service" begins! What lies in store for Kyoichiro is his siblings' merciless requests... Just then, a message arrives for Mutsumi.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Under Mutsumi's orders, Kyoichiro and Taiyo pursue the fleeing Momo. Taiyo manages to land a punch on Momo once, but the gap in abilities between himself and Momo, who can hold his own against Kyoichiro, is all too clear, and he's left on the defensive. On top of that, numerous Dark Cherries - creatures birthed by Tsubomi, which feed on humans as nutrients - appear, blocking the way. Taiyo launches another attack, but he falls just short, letting Momo get away. Kyoichiro destroys the Dark Cherries, and is about to take Taiyo back with him to Mutsumi, when he's suddenly summoned by the chairman of the Spy Association, Kai Izumo...
